review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.86-16.9.91: EXTENDS_TYPE_OF, FAILED_IMAGES, FINDLOC, FLOOR, FRACTION and GAMMA (batch191). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; EXTENDS_TYPE_OF covers both disassociated-pointer and unallocated-allocatable unlimited polymorphic arguments; FAILED_IMAGES is out of scope; FRACTION of a NaN is planned as 'is a NaN' with NaN identity recorded as having no portable oracle.
